# Evolving_System_Robustness

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The capacity of a network to maintain functionality and performance as its topology changes over time due to growth, rewiring, or failures. Understanding how topology evolution impacts robustness is critical for designing adaptive and fault-tolerant computing fabrics in TCC.
